actions.create_record.description: Creates a new record into a specified object/table.
actions.create_record_ai.description: Creates a Knack record from a JSON object of field values.
actions.create_record_ai.props.fields.de: JSON object keyed by Knack field key, e.g. {"field_1": "Jane"}.
actions.create_record_ai.props.object_ke: Knack object key such as object_1, from List Objects (Agent).
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.delete_record.description: Deletes an existing record from a table.
actions.delete_record.props.recordId.des: The ID of the record to delete.
actions.find_record.description: Finds a single record using field value.
actions.find_record.props.fieldId.descri: Field to find the record by
actions.find_record.props.fieldValue.des: The value to search for in the specified field.
actions.get_object_fields.description: Lists the fields of a Knack object.
actions.get_object_fields.props.object_k: Knack object key such as object_1, from List Objects (Agent).
actions.get_record.description: Gets one Knack record by its ID.
actions.get_record.props.object_key.desc: Knack object key such as object_1, from List Objects (Agent).
actions.get_record.props.record_id.descr: The 24-character record ID, e.g. from Search Records (Agent).
actions.list_objects.description: Lists the objects (tables) in the Knack app.
actions.search_records.description: Searches records in a Knack object with filter rules.
actions.search_records.props.match.descr: Whether a record must match all rules ("and") or any rule ("or").
Knack object key such as object_1, from List Objects (Agent).
actions.search_records.props.page.descri: Page number, starting at 1. Defaults to 1.
actions.search_records.props.rows_per_pa: Records per page, 1 to 1000. Defaults to 25.
Field key to sort by, e.g. "field_1".
actions.update_record.props.recordId.des: The ID of the record to update.
actions.update_record_ai.description: Updates fields of a Knack record from a JSON object.
actions.update_record_ai.props.fields.de: JSON object of the fields to change, keyed by Knack field key.
actions.update_record_ai.props.object_ke: Knack object key such as object_1, from List Objects (Agent).
actions.update_record_ai.props.record_id: The 24-character ID of the record to update.
auth.props.apiKey.description: Your Knack API Key available in the Settings section of the Builder.
auth.props.applicationId.description: Your Application ID available in the Settings section of the Builder.
